ambient_fill: low neutral room bounce preserves hand and cup texture while distant-wall tone shifts imply window frames and furniture outside the image

capture_contract.hdr: restrained tone mapping with a two-percent contrast increase; protect wall, cup and skin highlights and keep shadow detail open
capture_contract.texture: fine hand lines, tapered fingers, natural nail edges, cup thickness, liquid texture, subtle sensor noise and a moderately softer distant wall
capture_contract.white_balance: warm-neutral sunlight with slightly cooler neutral shadow, never amber or beige overall

forbidden: oversized cup or broad rugged hand
gray, green, beige, black, metallic or opaque straw
wall as sharp as the hand and cup

key_light.relative_size: small-to-medium directional window source with a real penumbra that broadens over wall distance
key_light.source: unfiltered late-afternoon window sunlight passing through a real opening

mood: natural eye-level sleeve-free handheld cold drink in direct window light with real wall separation and slightly firmer restrained contrast

reference_cluster.selection_rule: vertical warm-white interior planes, a single real window direction, compact connected shadows, protected transparent highlights and no cinematic orange cast

screen_light_map.falloff: gradual upper-right to lower-left falloff with moderate background detail attenuation
screen_light_map.gobo_geometry: broad soft partial window-frame and furniture shadows outside the frame, never connected sharply to the cup

shadow_contract.attachment: small grip occlusion remains attached to the hand-cup unit; wall shadows are broad, soft and spatially separated

cast_shadow.behavior: broad softened partial wall shadow with gradual density falloff from a distant hand-cup unit and unseen window/furniture occluders

contact_shadow.behavior: small dense occlusion around the lower fingers and nearest container edge; no detached halo

shadow_contract.edge: defined only at small grip occlusion; broad and soft on the distant wall

transmitted_light.behavior: faint beverage-colored lift remains within the transparent-container portion of the cast shadow

shadow_contract.transparent_material: glass and clear plastic preserve beverage-colored transmitted light; the weighted base and finger-contact edge retain more density
